name: complete-seo-skill
description: Comprehensive SEO analysis and optimization suite — technical audits, keyword research, on-page optimization, content evaluation, backlink analysis, competitor benchmarking, and more. Bundles Semrush/Ahrefs, Payload CMS, and Playwright MCP servers.

payload_mcp_url.title: Payload CMS MCP URL
payload_mcp_url.description: Full URL of your Payload MCP endpoint, e.g. https://your-site.com/api/mcp. Leave blank if you don't use Payload — the payload server will simply show as unconnected.

payload_api_key.title: Payload MCP API key
payload_api_key.description: API key from your Payload admin panel (MCP → API Keys). Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
